name: archebase-vi-guide
description: Use whenever a request involves ArcheBase / 智域基石 brand work: VI review, logo selection, brand colors or typography, PPTX/decks/BPs, web/product UI, social or press graphics, video/event screens, image sourcing or generation, or brand templates. Routes the work through the official VI Guide evidence, approved V2 assets, channel playbooks, deterministic validators and human release gates. For PPTX/POTX, use together with the shared pptx skill.
changelog: 2026-09-25h: v3.4.0. Made organization-wide use explicitly opt-in. Added strict/guided/creative/off modes, separated immutable hard boundaries from adjustable visual preferences, documented platform-native creative latitude, made brief/decision/release templates mode-aware, rewrote release gates by mode, and added validate_modes.py to keep the contract enforced. Social and campaign work may use creative mode without being treated as strict VI noncompliance, while Logo integrity, rights, privacy, claims and human approval remain hard boundaries.

2026-09-25g: v3.3.1. Audited the skill with skill-creator's quick validator and official Claude Agent Skills guidance. Moved version from unsupported top-level frontmatter into allowed metadata, added compatibility metadata, broadened the trigger description with concrete user language, and removed portable-skill dependence on local machine paths. The official GitHub/package audit now passes quick_validate.py.

2026-09-25f: v3.3.0. Audited the official 46-page VI Guide using a local verification copy (SHA-256 80680405ee05512878f5ecadc50cf32975d5a5d18c81b1ea17bcc8ad681493cb) instead of relying on OCR alone. Added assets/guide-evidence.json with seven evidence records and do_not_infer boundaries; added scripts/validate_guide_evidence.py with optional PDF page-count/hash verification; updated the page index, source manifest, route playbooks, checklist and architecture docs to load/cite the register. Corrected a prior under-specification: p.28 explicitly maps #0032FF=50%, #7172FA=25%, #619AFD=10% and #46CFFF=5%, but the labels total 90% and the remaining 10% is not assigned in the Guide; p.30–31 show #1E2124 background examples at 100%/5%, and p.32 shows text levels at 100%/70%/50%. Expanded tokens to preserve these facts while keeping semantic roles, compositing, clear-space, production fonts and naming as 待确认. Added evals/evals.json with three representative prompts.

2026-09-25e: v3.2.0. Made brand-asset immutability mechanical. The skill declared official assets immutable but asset-governance.md previously documented an 'adding or updating an asset' procedure that told a reader to edit the SVG paths — prose that contradicted the rule it was supposed to enforce. Replaced it with a 'Brand assets are immutable' section: a bundled asset is never edited, and a changed mark is a new official delivery that replaces it wholesale. Added assets/logo-checksums.json pinning all 59 assets by SHA-256 and scripts/validate_asset_integrity.py, wired into CI, which fails on any modification, addition or deletion; regeneration via --write is documented as the recorded act of accepting a delivery. Clarified in the manifest and resolver that 'editable' describes using the master, not altering the mark.

2026-09-25d: v3.1.3. Recorded that the SVG is the editable vector source, not a web-only export: no .ai file exists in the delivery and none is required, so its absence is not a gap. Verified all 25 SVGs are pure vector — <path> geometry, real <linearGradient> defs, a viewBox, no embedded raster <image> and no external references — and that the wordmark is outlined (no live <text>), which is standard for a logo. Added a vector_source block to the manifest, stated the rule in logo-asset-resolver.md, and rewrote the asset update steps in asset-governance.md to edit the SVG directly and regenerate the PNG through scripts/render_logo.sh.

2026-09-25c: v3.1.2. Recorded the brand owner's decision that 智域基石 Logo V2 is the correct version. Added approved_generation to the manifest naming the superseded set: the V1 generation (naming with no 纯色/渐变 split), the 2026-07-29 unreviewed raw export, and pre-V2 drafts. Added a 'Current generation — required' rule to logo-asset-resolver.md so a resolver cannot pick up an older name, and extended asset-governance.md to say superseded generations stay out of the bundle rather than being added as old_* for completeness. An absent variant is a 待确认 item, never a gap to reconstruct from an older generation.

2026-09-25b: v3.1.1. Re-verified the whole logo bundle byte-for-byte (SHA-256) against the official 智域基石 Logo V2 delivery folder, plus scripts/render_logo.sh --verify-all. Result: 25/25 SVG, 24/24 delivery PNG and 9/9 png-hires identical, and all 25 SVG re-renders match the bundled PNG bit-for-bit, so no asset needed re-syncing. Recorded the delivery's folder layout in the manifest's new source_layout field, which explains the earlier 24-vs-25 PNG discrepancy: the delivery's png/ holds 24 files while the bundle's png/ holds 25, because one 512px transparent PNG lives under the delivery's svg/ folder and was copied across so every SVG keeps a same-size raster pair. Also recorded that every png-hires shortfall originates in the official delivery, not in the bundle sync, and documented the re-verification procedure in asset-governance.md.

2026-09-25: v3.1.0. Completed Layer 2 — added the four missing route playbooks (web-ui, social, video-event, image-generation) and asset-governance.md; corrected the logo count from 24 to 25 in logo-manifest.json, logo-asset-resolver.md and guide-source-manifest.md; documented the png-hires naming and coverage gaps in logo-manifest.json known_gaps; rewrote the generic checklists as route-specific gates; added scripts/validate_asset_reference.py and scripts/check_doc_links.py; strengthened validate_tokens.py to enforce the approved Guide color set; removed two stray shell lines from architecture.md

2026-09-22: synced logo assets to 智域基石 Logo V2; bundled PNG raster delivery (assets/logos/png) and high-res icon exports (assets/logos/png-hires); added rendering rule because ImageMagick's internal SVG renderer mangles the gradient SVGs; added scripts/render_logo.sh; extended scripts/validate_logo_bundle.py
